corpusOrigin: Ten newly authored paragraphs after v4 mechanical rule freeze; five domains in both directions; no rules were tuned on these results. Final dist rerun is parity, not another blind set.
reviewType: AI-only dimension assessment; author is reviewer; no population accuracy claimed

rows.source: A differentiable function is continuous at the same point. The converse statement requires additional conditions; a graph without a visible gap is not by itself proof that a derivative exists.
rows.target: Sebuah fungsi dapat diturunkan adalah kontinu pada titik yang sama. Pernyataan konvers membutuhkan kondisi tambahan; grafik tanpa celah yang terlihat bukanlah dengan sendirinya bukti bahwa turunan ada.

rows.reviewerType: AI author/reviewer; not independent human adjudication
rows.reviewNote: Relasi dapat diturunkan/kontinu, syarat konvers, dan pembatas bukti grafik dipertahankan; sintaks kurang alami.

rows.source: Heating was stopped before the solvent boiled. The recorded rise in temperature cannot be attributed to the catalyst alone, because the heater also transferred energy to the solution.

rows.reviewerType: AI author/reviewer; not independent human adjudication
rows.reviewNote: Pemanasan menjadi pemanas dan boiled menjadi direbus kurang tepat; urutan berhenti sebelum mendidih dan penjelasan kausal kontribusi pemanas tetap dapat dipahami.

rows.source: A sample mean can differ from the population mean even when the sampling procedure is unbiased. The difference is not evidence that any observation was recorded incorrectly.

rows.reviewerType: AI author/reviewer; not independent human adjudication
rows.reviewNote: Population mean menjadi populasi berarti, sehingga besaran rata-rata populasi hilang. Negasi kesimpulan tentang pencatatan keliru masih ada.
